title: First State Bank and Trust
meta_description: First State Bank and Trust Mobile Banking Application
full_description: Enjoy banking anywhere, anytime with First State Bank's mobile banking app for your smartphone or tablet. The application allows you to safely and securely access your First State Bank account(s) using your mobile device.Features:* Access available balance information* View account history* Transfer funds between First State Bank accounts* Utilize the device GPS to get directions and access to branch locations and ATMs* Contact Us! Contact First State Bank directly from your device.First State Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC
